summary: Validated the 3 new features + regressions. Backend: 22/22 pytest passed including new tests for colored Excel Dashboard sheet (sheet order [Dashboard, Roster, Daily Check-Ins, RPE Log], traffic-light fills D4EDDA/FFF3CD/F8D7DA/F1F1F1 present), /api/trends?name=Messi (returns 7 days with load/sleep/hydration/motivation), and /api/settings/daily-email GET/POST persistence + auth. Frontend: coach login OK, athlete-name-Messi click opens athlete-trends-dialog with '7-Day Trends' title, three stat cards (Avg/Peak/Week Total) and two recharts SVG charts (training-load AreaChart + readiness LineChart). daily-email-card + daily-email-toggle work: ON->reload persists checked, OFF->reload persists unchecked, success toast shows 'turned ON/OFF'. Regression PASS: summary cards, squad table, refresh, export-excel-button, send-report-button, roster add/remove chip.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_credentials=True with default '*' origins is invalid per spec — set explicit CORS_ORIGINS in production.

scheduled_daily_email uses hourly cron gated by hour+last_sent; if service restarts across the trigger minute the day's email could be missed — acceptable for MVP but consider an APScheduler DateTrigger recomputed on settings change.
server.py now 583 lines — still fine, but Excel builder (~90 lines) is a natural extraction candidate.
AthleteTrendsDialog: avgLoad divisor filters days with load>0 but numerator uses totalLoad including all days (edge case matches intent since only >0 days contribute to total). Correct in practice.
seed_data_creation: Submitted a Messi check-in (RPE 7 x 60 min) so trends dialog has data; TEST_UI_Ath roster chip added and removed cleanly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features fully functional. Trends dialog uses recharts (SVG); note text is CSS uppercase-transformed so use case-insensitive text assertions. Daily-email toggle is a Radix Switch (data-state=checked/unchecked). Left toggle OFF at end of run.
